items.title: Bill Watrous interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 26, 1999
items.q: Anybody who has heard Fast Eddy Erickson play the banjo has to admit that this is a serious instrument.

ctx.x: Yeah. There’s different levels of bands. The Abelone Stompers for instance, up in Carmel, were a really good band. Old Jake Stock ran that band, and his son Jackson I believe runs it now, and there’s some great players: Fast Eddy Erickson and Jackie Coon and I mean there’s some really great players, no question about it. Anybody who has heard Fast Eddy Erickson play the banjo has to admit that this is a serious instrument.

And Jackie Coon is one of the seven wonders of the world and Buddy Jones up there, who used to play with Charlie Parker and played bass on “The Jack Sterling Show” back there in the 50s, they’ve all got quite a background behind them.
